summary: When a small town's only hospital closed, a family with a sick husband finally moved away to reach care.
realLife: A rural Alabama hospital closed in 2024, leaving the town without a hospital, obstetrician or pediatrician. A pastor's family made long trips for specialist care, and fuel, hotels and copays slowly ate their income until they moved. A grandchild on another state's Medicaid was turned away locally and the family paid about $1,500 for what proved a cold. Nearby hospitals shifted to a limited emergency form, and older parishioners still drive far for appointments.
sources: https://www.courthousenews.com/home-or-health-rural-hospital-closures-force-families-to-choose/ (Courthouse News report on Thomasville, Alabama families after the hospital closed)
